title: Add app icon assets for PWA install and Android TWA wrapper

requirements.text: Add generated PWA app icon image assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` matching the filenames already referenced by the web manifest and favicon link: `app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `app-icon.dim_512x512.png`.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_192x192.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.
`frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.
`frontend/public/manifest.json` continues to reference `/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png` and the files load successfully in the browser.

requirements.text: Add generated Android TWA icon and splash image assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` using the filenames documented in `frontend/android/README.md`: `android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png`, `android-icon-background.dim_432x432.png`, and `android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png`.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.
`frontend/public/assets/generated/android-icon-background.dim_432x432.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.
`frontend/public/assets/generated/android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png` exists and is a valid PNG image.

requirements.text: Update the Android TWA wrapper drawable resources to use the generated icon/splash assets, following `frontend/android/README.md`: copy/replace `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.png`, `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_background.png`, and `app/src/main/res/drawable/splash_image.png` with the corresponding generated PNGs from `frontend/public/assets/generated/` so the launcher icon (`@mipmap/ic_launcher`) and splash screen (`@drawable/splash_image`) render correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: After updating resources, the Android project has `frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.png`, `ic_launcher_background.png`, and `splash_image.png` present as valid PNGs.
The launcher icon continues to reference the adaptive icon defined in `frontend/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml` and renders without missing-resource errors.

The splash screen continues to reference `@drawable/splash_image` (as configured in `frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawable/splash_screen.xml` and `AndroidManifest.xml`) and renders without missing-resource errors.

constraints: Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI components).
Do not modify immutable hook/bootstrap files: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
Do not route icon/splash images through the backend; store them as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/`.
nonGoals: Changing the app name, theme colors, or PWA install flow behavior beyond ensuring icons/splash assets exist and are correctly wired.
Adding new backend functionality or altering Motoko canister state/schema.

required: App icon with warm tan/brown palette on light cream background (app-icon.dim_192x192.png, 192x192)
App icon with warm tan/brown palette on light cream background; maskable-safe composition (app-icon.dim_512x512.png, 512x512)
Android adaptive icon foreground graphic, transparent background (android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png, 432x432)
Android splash image with centered app mark on light cream background (android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png, 2732x2732)
